pan-card.title: [HI] PAN Card
pan-card.description: [HI] A Permanent Account Number (PAN) is a ten-character alphanumeric identifier, issued in the form of a laminated "PAN card", by the Indian Income Tax Department.
pan-card.purpose: [HI] Essential for financial transactions, filing income tax returns, and as a proof of identity.
pan-card.eligibility: [HI] Any Indian citizen, NRI, or foreign citizen who pays taxes in India.
pan-card.importantNotes: [HI] Ensure the name on the PAN application perfectly matches your Aadhaar card to avoid rejection.
pan-card.recentUpdates: [HI] Aadhaar-PAN linking deadline was strictly enforced. Non-linked PAN cards become inoperative.
pan-card.commonMistakes: [HI] Mismatch of name or date of birth between Aadhaar and application form.

aadhaar-card.title: [HI] Aadhaar Card
aadhaar-card.description: [HI] Aadhaar is a 12-digit individual identification number issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India on behalf of the Government of India.
aadhaar-card.purpose: [HI] Used as a primary proof of identity and address across India for various government and non-government services.
aadhaar-card.eligibility: [HI] Any resident of India, including infants.
aadhaar-card.approxFees: [HI] Free for enrollment, ₹50 for demographic updates.
aadhaar-card.importantNotes: [HI] Keep your mobile number linked to Aadhaar updated at all times.
aadhaar-card.recentUpdates: [HI] Document update is free online for Aadhaar cards issued more than 10 years ago.
aadhaar-card.commonMistakes: [HI] Submitting blurred or outdated documents for updates.

passport.title: [HI] Passport Application
passport.description: [HI] An Indian passport is issued by the Ministry of External Affairs to citizens of India for the purpose of international travel.
passport.purpose: [HI] International travel and strong proof of citizenship and identity.
passport.importantNotes: [HI] Tatkaal applications are processed faster but require extra fees.
passport.recentUpdates: [HI] DigiLocker integration allows fetching documents directly without hard copies.
passport.commonMistakes: [HI] Providing incorrect address or mismatched signatures.

driving-license.title: [HI] Driving License
driving-license.description: [HI] A driving license is an official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles.
driving-license.purpose: [HI] Legal permission to drive and acts as a valid identity proof.
driving-license.eligibility: [HI] 18+ years of age (16+ for gearless vehicles).
driving-license.importantNotes: [HI] A physical driving test is mandatory at the RTO.
driving-license.recentUpdates: [HI] Many RTO services are now fully faceless in several states.
driving-license.commonMistakes: [HI] Failing to bring the vehicle of the correct class for the driving test.

voter-id.title: [HI] Voter ID
voter-id.description: [HI] The Indian voter ID card is issued by the Election Commission of India. Its main purpose is as identity proof while casting votes.
voter-id.purpose: [HI] Voting rights and general identity verification.
voter-id.eligibility: [HI] Indian citizen of 18 years or older.
voter-id.importantNotes: [HI] Form 6 is used for new voter registration.
voter-id.recentUpdates: [HI] You can now link Aadhaar with your Voter ID via Form 6B.
voter-id.commonMistakes: [HI] Registering in multiple constituencies, which is illegal.

birth-certificate.title: [HI] Birth Certificate
birth-certificate.description: [HI] A birth certificate is a vital record that documents the birth of a person. It is the first right of a child and establishes their identity.
birth-certificate.purpose: [HI] Proof of age, citizenship, and identity for school admissions, passports, etc.
birth-certificate.importantNotes: [HI] Late registration requires an affidavit and a higher fee.
birth-certificate.recentUpdates: [HI] Digital birth certificates are increasingly available via DigiLocker.

income-certificate.title: [HI] Income Certificate
income-certificate.description: [HI] An official statement provided by the state government confirming the annual income of a person or a family.
income-certificate.purpose: [HI] Required for scholarships, fee concessions, and reserving quotas for EWS.
income-certificate.eligibility: [HI] Citizens needing proof of their economic status.
income-certificate.importantNotes: [HI] Ensure the income details match your actual filings to avoid legal issues.
income-certificate.recentUpdates: [HI] Many states offer instant certificates if linked with E-KYC.
income-certificate.commonMistakes: [HI] Failing to include income from all sources (e.g., agriculture, rent).

caste-certificate.title: [HI] Caste Certificate
caste-certificate.description: [HI] Documentary proof of an individual belonging to a specific caste, as listed under the Indian Constitution (SC, ST, OBC).
caste-certificate.purpose: [HI] Availing reservations in education and government jobs.
caste-certificate.importantNotes: [HI] OBC applicants may also need to provide a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate.
caste-certificate.recentUpdates: [HI] Central vs State caste lists can differ; apply for the one you need.
caste-certificate.commonMistakes: [HI] Applying for a Central Government job with a State-specific caste certificate.

domicile-certificate.title: [HI] Domicile Certificate
domicile-certificate.description: [HI] A document issued by the state government proving that a person is a resident of a particular state/UT.
domicile-certificate.purpose: [HI] State-level quotas in educational institutions and government jobs.
domicile-certificate.eligibility: [HI] Residents who have lived in the state for a specified number of years (varies).
domicile-certificate.importantNotes: [HI] A person can possess a domicile certificate from only one state.
domicile-certificate.recentUpdates: [HI] Some states have simplified the process for students via schools.
domicile-certificate.commonMistakes: [HI] Not maintaining consecutive years of address proofs.

water-connection.title: [HI] Water Connection
water-connection.description: [HI] Application for a new municipal water supply connection to a residential or commercial property.
water-connection.purpose: [HI] To secure legally supplied, safe drinking water.
water-connection.approxFees: [HI] Varies based on pipe size and property type
water-connection.importantNotes: [HI] Illegal connections can result in heavy fines and legal action.
water-connection.recentUpdates: [HI] Online portals now allow tracking the status of the connection.
water-connection.commonMistakes: [HI] Not clearing previous property tax dues before applying.

electricity-bill.title: [HI] Electricity Bill
electricity-bill.description: [HI] View and pay your monthly electricity consumption bills online.
electricity-bill.purpose: [HI] Maintain uninterrupted power supply to your premises.
electricity-bill.eligibility: [HI] Registered consumers with a valid Consumer Number.
electricity-bill.importantNotes: [HI] Pay before the due date to avoid late payment surcharges.
electricity-bill.recentUpdates: [HI] Smart meters allow prepaid recharging in many cities.

property-tax.title: [HI] Property Tax
property-tax.description: [HI] Annual tax paid to the local government or municipal corporation by the owner of real estate.
property-tax.purpose: [HI] Funding local infrastructure like roads, sewage, and parks.
property-tax.approxFees: [HI] Based on property size, location, and type
property-tax.importantNotes: [HI] Keep the payment receipt safely, it acts as a strong proof of ownership.
property-tax.recentUpdates: [HI] Geo-tagging of properties is becoming mandatory in several cities.
property-tax.commonMistakes: [HI] Not updating property records after adding new floors/construction.

sewer-connection.title: [HI] Sewer Connection
sewer-connection.description: [HI] Application for connecting the household wastewater line to the municipal sewerage network.
sewer-connection.eligibility: [HI] Property owners in areas with an active sewer network.
sewer-connection.importantNotes: [HI] A site inspection will be conducted before approval.
sewer-connection.recentUpdates: [HI] Integration with water connection applications for a single-window process.
sewer-connection.commonMistakes: [HI] Hiring unauthorized plumbers to connect to the main line.

marriage-certificate.title: [HI] Marriage Certificate
marriage-certificate.description: [HI] An official statement that two people are married. It is registered under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 or the Special Marriage Act, 1954.
marriage-certificate.purpose: [HI] Required for joint visas, changing name, and claiming spouse benefits.
marriage-certificate.importantNotes: [HI] Witnesses with valid ID proofs must be present at the registrar office.
marriage-certificate.recentUpdates: [HI] Online registration followed by a single physical visit is now the norm.
marriage-certificate.commonMistakes: [HI] Not carrying the original documents on the date of appointment.

death-certificate.title: [HI] Death Certificate
death-certificate.description: [HI] An official document issued by the government, which declares cause of death, location of death, time of death and some other personal information about the deceased.
death-certificate.purpose: [HI] Settlement of property inheritance, insurance claims, and bank accounts.
death-certificate.eligibility: [HI] Next of kin of the deceased.
death-certificate.importantNotes: [HI] Ensure multiple copies are requested as they will be required at various institutions.
death-certificate.recentUpdates: [HI] Hospitals now directly push death data to the municipal registry portal.
death-certificate.commonMistakes: [HI] Delaying registration beyond 21 days, which requires magisterial order.

pension.title: [HI] Pension
pension.description: [HI] Assistance for senior citizens, widows, or differently-abled individuals under various government schemes (e.g. IGNOAPS).
pension.eligibility: [HI] Based on age (usually 60+), disability, or widowhood, often with income caps.
pension.importantNotes: [HI] Aadhaar seeding with the bank account is mandatory for receiving pension via DBT.
pension.recentUpdates: [HI] Face authentication via smartphone is now accepted for Jeevan Pramaan.
pension.commonMistakes: [HI] Forgetting the annual Life Certificate submission, leading to paused pension.

health-card.title: [HI] Health Card
health-card.description: [HI] ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) or PM-JAY card for health records and insurance coverage.
health-card.purpose: [HI] Digital health records and access to free medical treatment up to 5 Lakhs (if eligible).
health-card.eligibility: [HI] ABHA is for everyone; PM-JAY has specific income/demographic criteria.
health-card.importantNotes: [HI] Keep your ABHA number handy during hospital visits to digitize your prescriptions.
health-card.recentUpdates: [HI] ABHA is now integrated with the CoWIN and Aarogya Setu apps.
health-card.commonMistakes: [HI] Creating multiple ABHA accounts instead of linking previous records.
